name: Danielle Spain
story: Danielle Spain appears in the 2017 New Zealand Esri User Conference programme as an Eagle Technology technical presenter. She co-presented two ArcGIS Online sessions with Esri’s Bernie Szukalski, documenting the local technical-support and training work around the move from desktop GIS to hosted web mapping.
